observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox 360 console with a wireless controller. The console has the 'XBOX 360' logo on the front. The controller is black with standard color buttons (green, red, blue, yellow).
Photo 1 shows a white Xbox 360 console with a white wireless controller. The console has the 'XBOX 360' logo on the front. The controller is white with standard color buttons.
Both consoles appear to be the same model, likely the Xbox 360 S (slim) version, based on the design and size.
The seller's text mentions 'No Red light model', 'Xbox 360 Console LIVE', 'Xbox 360 120GB Hard Drive', and 'Xbox 360 Wireless Controller'.
The photos do not show any internal components, power supply, cables, or the hard drive. The console's disc tray is closed in both photos.
The watermark 'EDNET STORES LTD POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on both photos, suggesting stock images rather than real photos of the item for sale.

claims.evidence: The photos show the exterior only; internal hardware and the red light issue cannot be confirmed remotely. The 'Red Ring of Death' is an internal hardware failure not visible in photos.
The photos do not show any sign of an active Live membership or account. The console's screen or dashboard is not visible. The claim about Live status cannot be verified from the images.
The hard drive is not visible in the photos. The console's front panel does not show a hard drive bay or any indicator of storage capacity. The claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
Photo 0 and photo 1 both show a wireless controller with the standard Xbox 360 design, including the D-pad, analog sticks, and color buttons. The controller appears to be genuine.
